answers.core: Alerts like this are in the interest of users. They improve the UI, and this one is an extremely lightweight addition.
answers.workaround: This is a minor fix to increase godot's intuitiveness by giving the user accurate feedback. Users won't know it's a problem until after they've wasted time on it, and there's very little that can be done afterwards.

title: Add Alerts when In-AnimationTree loads fail
